thread:
Priya: quick sync — QA found a perf regression when tenant-level embeddings cache is enabled (p95 latency up ~120ms on 8k seq). This is on the MVP branch. Need to decide cuts or mitigations for the milestone reset. TL;DR: can we ship MVP without full embeddings cache or do a staged rollout?
Jordan: do we have the repro + perf logs?
Priya: yes, attaching summary in the ticket but here's the short: repro on embedded-history workload, batch sizes ~6, GPU memory pressure spikes and KV thrash.
Lee: we saw increased GPU mem allocs at the same time as longer GC pauses; looks like cache size + autoscale policy colliding. p95 went from 110ms -> 230ms for some tenants.
Sam: short options: 1) disable embeddings cache for MVP (fall back to sync recompute), 2) keep cache but cap max entries to 25% and soft-ttl, 3) ship with cache behind feature flag + canary 5% tenants. Option 1 fastest, 3 safest for regressions.
Anya: if we disable cache, UX needs a one-liner banner for affected tenants: "Embeddings cache temporarily disabled for launch; content stays accurate but search may be slower." Minimal design, can ship today.
Marta: customer impact: 2 pilot customers surfaced search flakiness, but both prefer a predictable rollout over intermittent slowness. They'd accept a deferred cache as long as we call it out.
Jordan: engineering effort estimates: option 1 ~ 4 engineer-days to toggle config + test; option 3 ~ 10 engineer-days to add canary routing + telemetry.
Priya: constraint: we have a feature-freeze in 6 working days. If we pick option 1 now, we can keep the current milestone. Option 3 requires a 2-week slip for safe validation.
Sam: quick patch for option 1 (config toggle) — snippet I can land:
```json
{
  "features": {
    "embeddings_cache": {
      "enabled": false,
      "max_entries": 0
    }
  }
}
```
Sam: I'll add a boolean flag 'mvp.embcache.disabled' with rollout=true for the branch. Tests + smoke in staging.
Lee: infra note — if we flip to disabled we avoid the autoscaler oscillation that caused the GC spikes. Good from SLO perspective.
Priya: proposed decision: do option 1 (disable embeddings cache for MVP), mark cache as a v1 feature, and schedule canary plan for v1 with telemetry and SLO gates. Can we get confirmations? @Jordan @Sam @Anya
Jordan: +1, keeps milestone intact.
Sam: +1, will open PR by EOD and add staging smoke job.
Anya: +1, will produce the banner copy and a small FAQ.
Marta: +1 from customer success — I'll notify the pilots and include the justification.
Priya: action items: Sam — PR + staging smoke (due: 2026-03-27), Jordan/Lee — adjust autoscale policy for canary path and prepare perf dashboards (due: 2026-03-29), Anya — banner + FAQ (due: 2026-03-26), Marta — customer comms (due: 2026-03-26). I'll update the milestone tracker and mark "embeddings cache" as deferred to v1.
release-bot: deploy check queued — review required for config toggle.
Priya: noted — we'll run the toggle behind the branch flag and validate rollout in staging before merge. If any perf regressions persist after the toggle, we escalate to the oncall.
Jordan: one follow-up — can we add an instrumentation point to capture cache hit-rate and KV eviction rate once we re-enable? Preferably a lightweight metric in the runtime.
Sam: yes, adding a simple counter + histogram, will tie into the per-route cost dashboard.
Priya: thanks everyone. Will close loop in the milestone doc and update the launch checklist. :thumbsup:
